risk_description:
The screwed junction of the steering column at the level of the steering unit may be defective due to a production error. 
As a result, the steering column may detach from the steering unit and cause a failure of the steering system, increasing the risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not meet the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
